messages.author: c2c61724291ed0c9
messages.subject: Help!
parts:
I am using Windows 10 Home, and R version 4.1.0. I try to run the Barrier model in Section 5.2 of the book, "Advanced Spatial Modeling with Stochastic Partial Differential Equations Using R and INLA". I get the message: "Fatal error: unable to initialize the JIT", when I reach the coding:
res.barrier <- inla(form.barrier,
                    family = 'gaussian',
                    control.predictor = list(A = inla.stack.A(stk)),
                    control.inla = list(int.strategy = "eb"),
                    data = inla.stack.data(stk))

Could you please help me out. How could this error be avoided?

Thanks in advance.

Charlie
